claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase.attachment.item_or_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Tree Form changes the staff itself into a planted tree and later reverts that same object. The current activation surface has alter_item_kind but no honest item/object attachment target for direct activations.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can take a Magic action to plant one end of the staff in earth in an unoccupied space and expend 1 charge to transform the staff into a healthy tree. While touching the tree and using a Magic action, you return the staff to its normal form."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: fall_on_end
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Reverting the tree back into a staff forces creatures in the tree to fall. The v4 taxonomy names this concept, but the current TS surface does not expose it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Any creature in the tree falls when the tree reverts to a staff."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.depower_on_last_charge
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The staff is not destroyed when the last-charge mishap triggers; it remains as a nonmagical Quarterstaff. Existing destruction policies only cover destruction or exhaustion, not partial shutdown into a mundane remnant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff loses its properties and becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff."
